items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1974-01-01
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] See, I have old posters that John Robichoke said... [INTERVIEWEE] All of them was that I knew was the Pelican, the Pelican Stadium.

ctx.x: town and I used to go to the old Crescent Star Park, which was back in town, as you used to say, and went on the outside for a foul ball to come over and scramble with the other kids and get the ball and go in. What was the first time? Somewhere in back town. I can't remember the exact location. Look it up. And I'm sure some of the more at least can pin-pink the question so far. What about the Dixie Park? I don't know anything about the Dixie Park.

See, I have old posters that John Robichoke said, you know, that you wouldn't even remember the places of the team. Now, I don't know whether they, you know, at that time, but I don't know if they lasted on into your time. John Robichoke said he'd say things for years and years. Anyway, Dixie Park, I've seen about Lincoln and Johnson Park and Oleander Park. Those were uptown folks. Yeah, those would be three uptown folks. No, I didn't go up there. Or Carrollton, as they would say. Carrollton, that's right. I…
All of them was that I knew was the Pelican, the Pelican Stadium. Did you play that? They got mostly the white teams.
